## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **RepoDownloader-Setup-….exe** | Installer (recommended). Adds a Start Menu shortcut and an uninstaller. No admin rights needed. |
| RepoDownloader-…-portable.exe | The app on its own. No install: just run it. |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | Checksums, if you want to verify your download. |

**You also need [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads) installed.**

### "Windows protected your PC"?
The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen warns about it the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
Every release is built from this repo's source by GitHub Actions. You can see the build log on the Actions tab.
